The graphical abstract image prints a third value (9.34 mmol/L, described in its alt text); that image value is pixel content kept in visual.json, not a fact or a conflict side.

Starting body weight is 87.5 kg (pre-Mazdutide evaluation, Table 2 Baseline, Table 2 footnote) versus 87.8 kg (Results text), each given as the start of the same change to 71.0 kg. The printed change of -16.8 kg matches 87.8 kg while the printed -18.86% matches 87.5 kg.

End-of-treatment BMI is 24.86 kg/m² in the Results paragraph but 24.85 kg/m² in Table 2 (weeks 36 and 42) and its footnote; a rounding-level difference recorded as an ambiguity, not a conflict. The graphical abstract image also prints 24.86 (pixel content, visual.json only).

The abstract reports the HbA1c fall of 21.88% and uric acid drop of 37.00% "After 36 weeks", while Table 2 and its footnote give them as Week 42 vs. Baseline (HbA1c 8.8 and uric acid 372 at Week 36). Week 42 falls after week 36, so the wording is compatible and is not treated as a timing conflict.

Table 2 prints NA in several cells (Week 14 HbA1c and uric acid, Week 28 lipids, ultrasound row apart from Baseline and Week 14); the source does not say whether these were not performed, not available or not applicable.

The patient is called 15 years old while the case states a birth month and year that, with the 2024 evaluation dates, do not obviously give 15 at presentation; the date of birth is an identifier and is not stored.

Results paragraph b00029 prints generic normal ranges (for example uric acid 149 – 416 μmol/L for males, total cholesterol 2.9 – 5.18 mmol/L) that differ from the reference values printed with the March 2024 evaluation (uric acid <428 μmol/L, total cholesterol <6.0 mmol/L).

Figure 1 plots weight, BMI and fasting glucose weekly through about week 43, but no data labels are printed; values read from the plotted curves are not recorded as facts and do not override the text and Table 2.

Table 1 is titled a drug dosage adjustment plan, while the text describes the phases as the protocol that was carried out; Table 1 rows are cited as evidence for the same phase items as the narrative.

The insulin/metformin adjustment is dated to a March 2024 follow-up visit and followed by "After six weeks of this regimen", yet the pre-Mazdutide evaluation is also dated March 2024 "immediately prior to initiating Mazdutide therapy"; the source does not reconcile the dates.
